messages.author: a5e83218c834e013
messages.subject: Computing autocovariances with an FFT
parts:
The manual sources

Geyer, C. J. (2011). Introduction to Markov chain Monte Carlo.
In Brooks, S., Gelman, A., Jones, G. L., and Meng, X.-L., editors,
Handbook of Markov Chain Monte Carlo

when discussing FFT estimators, but as far as I can tell that
article never discusses FFTs. Is there a proper estimator or
did I miss something?

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] Computing autocovariances with an FFT
parts:
We should add a citation for using FFT to estimate autocovariance.
Matt worked out the math and I blogged it:

http://lingpipe-blog.com/2012/06/08/autocorrelation-fft-kiss-eigen/

If that's not in the doc, it should be!

Still no citation, though. I also have no idea how good the computation is.

- Bob
